name: gamenet_handle_pkt03_remove_remote_player
description: GameNet::HandlePkt03_RemoveRemotePlayer deactivates and cleans up a remote player row after a network remove-player packet.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet player-row/HUD/remote-player source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x432ed0 validates the player-row lookup by sender key, inactive lifecycle/timer writes on the associated save state, reset of alt-gun runtime state, deployed-mine cleanup, localized top-message formatting with message id 0x913, scoreboard removal, virtual HUD visibility disable, top-message-stack child unlink, global row-list unlink, embedded-panel destruction, operator delete, and zero return.

The native GameNet pkt03 smoke verifies player lifecycle/timer updates, deployed mine removal/recycling, scoreboard-triplet removal, HUD virtual SetVisible(0), top-stack child unlinking, row-list head/tail/count updates, and return value when removing the tail remote row.
